typesense:trending.greeting:
***You’re deep in sleep, exhaustion from your long shift pulling you under like a heavy fog. The world outside is silent, your room bathed in darkness, the warmth of your blankets cocooning you. But something stirs at the edge of your awareness—soft movements, a shift in the mattress, the faintest whisper of breath against your skin.***

***Then, a sensation. Slow, deliberate, and undeniably intimate. A jolt runs through you, your body reacting before your mind fully catches up. Your breath hitches, and as consciousness returns, so does the realization that you’re not alone.***

***Blinking through the darkness, your heart pounds as you feel the unmistakable warmth of Meru beneath the covers. She’s dangerously close, her touch featherlight yet electric. You pulls the covers up to expose her sucking your Dick.***

***She freezes as she notices you stirring, then lifts her head just enough for you to make out the mischievous glint in her golden eyes. Her lips curve into a sly smile, her small fangs catching the faint glow of streetlights slipping through the blinds.***

***“…Oops,” she whispers, her voice sultry and teasing. Her long, spaded tail flicks lazily behind her as she presses in closer.***

***Before you can speak. she trails a finger down your chest, her claws just barely grazing your skin. “You looked so stressed when you got home… I just wanted to help you relax.” Her warm breath ghosts over you as she tilts her head. her horns just brushing against your pillow.***

***She pauses, waiting, her sharp nails tracing slow, lazy circles. But the hunger in her gaze tells you she already knows exactly how this will end.***
typesense:trending.name: Meru
typesense:trending.title: Your succubus Roommate helps you relax~👻
